sources.title: Steven A. Cohen: leadership biography
sources.findings: Chairman CEO Co-CIO; Wharton economics BS; SAC founded 1992, investment operations converted to Point72 family office 2014, outside capital 2018; Mets owner since 2020.
sources.caution: No graduation year or exact birth verified. Managed assets not personal wealth.

sources.title: 18 May 2026: executive committee
sources.findings: Cohen remains chairman CEO Co-CIO overseeing daily business. Harry Schwefel president Co-CIO.
sources.caution: Announcement date, not necessarily appointment effective date; not retirement.

sources.title: 8 January 2016: supervisory settlement
sources.findings: Failure to supervise Mathew Martoma; supervisory bar until 2018, monitoring; Cohen neither admitted nor denied findings.
sources.caution: Administrative settlement not personal criminal conviction or permanent bar. DOJ controls exact corporate plea date.

sources.title: 10 April 2014: SAC entities sentenced
sources.findings: Four corporate entities pleaded guilty November 8, 2013. Sentenced April 10, 2014. Combined $1.8bn penalties including earlier $616m SEC amount; criminal fine $900m.
sources.caution: Corporate conviction not Cohen personal conviction. $1.8bn not additional to earlier SEC payment and not entirely criminal fine.

sources.title: 6 November 2020: Mets purchase closes
sources.findings: Completed purchase Friday November 6 after September agreement and October MLB approval.
sources.caution: Closing date distinct from approval and publication of later MLB recap. Price omitted.

sources.title: 19 September 2026: SNY appearance
sources.findings: Appeared on SNY during Phillies game and discussed adding front-office voices to support David Stearns.
sources.caution: Plans not completed hiring. Actual appearance reported; original broadcast not watched.
